description: Geodätische Basisdatenbank GeoBas, WFS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The Web Feature Service for the GeoBas (Geodetic Base Database) provides the basic geodetic data (point objects and line objects) of the Federal Water and Shipping Administration (WSV). The WFS data includes all point and line data of the GeoBas on the federal waterways with direct access to the primary database. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Basic Geodetic Database GeoBas, WFS" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vermessung, Wasserstraßen. The listing shows 2025-02-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
